{{Quote|For Mandalore!|GenoHaradan thug|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Rally Master]] in [[Mandalore the Ultimate]]'s [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] army. Following his [[Mandalorian/Legends|people's]] defeat in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] this [[Gender/Legends|man]] found employment with the [[GenoHaradan]]: a secret society of elite [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] dedicated to eliminating enemies of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

The thug wielded a double-bladed [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in combat, which was laced with a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] unique to the GenoHaradan.

==Behind the scenes==
===Non-canon dark side story===
After [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] met [[Hulas]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] in [[3956 BBY]] and accepted his proposal to kill the other GenoHaradan leaders, he was soon betrayed by Hulas himself. This Mandalorian, along with other GenoHaradan hunters and assassins fought Revan in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by him.
